title: Mixed source step: Sil's fourth-power transfer inside Collet's pool step
description: Proves the all-moduli Dirichlet boundary 437037/500000 = 0.874074, with the principal pole excluded. New theorem: a mixed source step. In Collet's NF source step the LOW price of a step from a face (B0, L0) to (B, L) is paid by a pool of fresh sixth-power amplifiers of width a at rate 1 - 6q B0/L0, so a step descends only while L0 > 6q B0. The mixed step keeps the pool and in addition transfers a block J of the input's own live slots, of total width delta, into the row label by Sil's fourth-power identity G(D^4 k) = chi(D)^2 G(k) at the first MAIN layer. After Cauchy-Schwarz over the selected products the count cancels the renormalization V -> V/prod_J P exactly, and booked against the original first-layer target the residual saves exactly delta (Collet's label side has slope 1 in the volume). The LOW payment becomes a(1 - 6q beta) + delta(1 + q - 6q beta) >= q X0 + r, so the step descends whenever L0 > 6q B0/(1 + q). Collision columns p^2 m are handled by a mod-p^2 sublattice lemma and supplier columns of the seed by a supplier split. In Lean the step is nf_step3 (Source/NFStep3.lean): the transfer (Transfer/, Collision/, Residual/), virtual nodes and gates derived from the certificates (Ledger/), and Collet's LOW/HIGH waist forked with two parents (the original input for the first layer, the residual for the second) and two amplitudes (ForkMx/, Downstream/); Collet's MAIN-layer machinery is reused unchanged on the residual. The source chain starts on Sil's fourth-power face (through arvi-repeated-marks-on-sil-face-20261025) at s = 0.016, runs through a fan of 46 mixed steps to the stall line L/B = 6q/(1+q), and then along a fine face family (8 polynomial pieces of 2^16 grid steps, uniform certificates; the threshold makes the mixed denominator exactly 2^-15 at every step) to the count face (0.9638418, 2.0972320) and the physical face (0.9657869, 2.1306183); on the last piece the face cap grows as 3/40 + y/100, giving caps 0.0850 and 0.0805. The final return (Collet's, forked as in arvi-repeated-marks-on-sil-face-20261025) uses the switch bound only as dMinus > 1/2, which is all its uses need, and Lemma W, which opens Collet's three conservative count windows (lower plain window 2/5, width window below the cap, natural-tail join at m_H) to the faces' proved domain and joins the natural tail at the crossover where the face width equals the natural width; with h = 403/500 it closes at 437037/500000 (exact theta* = 0.8740728; 33 rows, 14 admission windows). The research, drafting and Lean development were AI-assisted.
